events.title: 후난 상음의 가난한 농가에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born to a poor farming family in Xiangyin, Hunan
events.description: 후난성 상음현의 가난한 농가에서 태어났다. 어려서부터 학문에 재주를 보였다.
events.description_en: He was born to a poor farming family in Xiangyin County, Hunan. He showed a gift for scholarship from an early age.

events.title: 거인이 되고도 회시에 세 번 낙방하다
events.title_en: He passed the provincial exam but failed the metropolitan exam three times
events.description: 스무 살에 거인이 되었다. 이어 여섯 해 동안 베이징에서 회시를 세 번 치렀지만 모두 낙방했고, 진사의 길을 포기하고 농학과 지리를 파고들었다.
events.description_en: At twenty he passed the provincial examination and became a juren. Over the next six years he sat the metropolitan exam in Beijing three times and failed each one. He gave up the path to the jinshi degree and threw himself into agronomy and geography instead.

events.title: 임칙서를 만나 서역 자료를 넘겨받다
events.title_en: He met Lin Zexu and received his files on the Western Regions
events.description: 창사 인근에서 임칙서를 만나 밤새 이야기를 나눴다. 임칙서는 그의 식견에 감탄해 자신이 모은 서역 관련 자료를 모두 건넸다.
events.description_en: Near Changsha he met Lin Zexu and the two talked through the night. Impressed by his insight, Lin handed over everything he had gathered on the Western Regions.

events.title: 장사를 지켜내고 증국번의 추천을 받다
events.title_en: He defended Changsha and won Zeng Guofan's recommendation
events.description: 태평천국군이 창사를 에워싸자 후난 순무의 참모로 들어가 성을 지켜냈다. 이 공으로 증국번의 추천을 받아 4품 관직에 올랐다.
events.description_en: When Taiping forces besieged Changsha, he joined the Hunan governor's staff and helped hold the city. The feat won him Zeng Guofan's recommendation and a fourth-rank post.

events.title: 절강순무가 되어 태평천국군과 싸우다
events.title_en: He became governor of Zhejiang and fought the Taiping army
events.description: 절강순무에 임명되어 청군과 프랑스·영국 군대를 함께 지휘하며 태평천국군을 절강에서 몰아냈다.
events.description_en: Appointed governor of Zhejiang, he commanded Qing forces together with French and British troops and drove the Taiping army out of the province.

events.title: 민절총독으로 승진하다
events.title_en: He was promoted to Viceroy of Fujian and Zhejiang
events.description: 민절총독으로 승진해 복건과 절강 두 성을 함께 다스렸다.
events.description_en: He was promoted to Viceroy of Fujian and Zhejiang, governing both provinces together.

events.title: 마웨이에 복주선정국을 세우다
events.title_en: He founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard at Mawei
events.description: 푸저우 마웨이에 중국 최초의 근대식 조선소인 복주선정국과 해군 학당을 세웠다. 증기 군함을 자국 기술로 만들려는 첫 시도였다.
events.description_en: At Mawei near Fuzhou he founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard and a naval academy, China's first modern shipyard. It was the first attempt to build steam warships with domestic technology.

events.title: 섬감총독이 되어 회민 봉기 진압에 나서다
events.title_en: He became governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu to put down the Muslim rebellion
events.description: 섬서·감숙 총독에 임명되어 그 지역에서 일어난 회민 봉기를 진압하는 임무를 맡았다.
events.description_en: He was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu and took charge of suppressing the Muslim rebellion that had broken out there.

events.title: 둔전과 조세 정비로 서북을 평정하다
events.title_en: He pacified the northwest through taxation and land reform
events.description: 1868년부터 감숙과 섬서에서 회민 봉기군과 싸우면서 조세를 정비하고 둔전을 늘려 병참을 스스로 해결했다. 큰 결전보다 차근한 진격으로 지역을 하나씩 되찾았다.
events.description_en: From 1868 he fought the Muslim rebels in Gansu and Shaanxi while overhauling taxation and expanding military farms to feed his own army. Rather than seeking one great battle, he advanced steadily and retook the region district by district.

events.title: 관을 메고 신강으로 나가 야쿠브 벡을 무너뜨리다
events.title_en: He marched into Xinjiang with his own coffin and crushed Yaqub Beg
events.description: 예순을 넘긴 나이에 자신의 관을 수레에 실어 신강으로 진군했다. 1878년까지 야쿠브 벡 정권을 무너뜨리고 신강을 다시 청의 판도로 되찾았다.
events.description_en: Past sixty, he marched into Xinjiang with his own coffin loaded on a cart, a sign that he would not return alive if he failed. By 1878 he had crushed Yaqub Beg's regime and brought Xinjiang back under Qing rule.

events.title: 일리를 돌려받다
events.title_en: Ili was returned to Qing rule
events.description: 신강 승리로 러시아를 압박한 끝에 상트페테르부르크 조약이 맺어져, 1871년 러시아가 점령했던 일리 지역을 돌려받았다.
events.description_en: His victories in Xinjiang put pressure on Russia, leading to the Treaty of Saint Petersburg. Russia returned the Ili region, which it had occupied since 1871.

events.title: 청프전쟁 중 푸저우에서 죽다
events.title_en: He died in Fuzhou during the Sino-French War
events.description_en: He died in Fuzhou in 1885, in the midst of the Sino-French War.
